scripts.connect:db:dev: docker exec -it dev-kitchen psql -U dratharias -d dev-kitchen
scripts.clean: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker system prune -f && docker system prune -a --volumes -f
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && rm -fr dist node_modules package-lock.json && cd ..
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && rm -fr node_modules package-lock.json && cd ..
scripts.clean:db:nuke: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker volume rm dev-kitchen_data || true && npm run up:build && npm run prisma:build
scripts.install:all:ci: cd frontend && npm ci && cd ../backend && npm ci && npx tsc --build && cd ..
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && npx tsc --build && cd ..
scripts.update:all: npm run update:frontend && npm run update:backend
scripts.update:all:install: npm run update:all && npm run install:all
scripts.prisma:generate: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma generate'
scripts.prisma:migrate: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.prisma:push: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma db push'
scripts.prisma:baseline: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 20240101000000_init'
scripts.prisma:init: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx prisma generate'
scripts.prisma:build: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma generate && sleep 2 && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && sleep 2 && node /app/prisma/seed.js'
scripts.nuke: docker compose down && npm run clean:all && npm run update:all:install && npm run up:build && npm run prisma:build
